summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K announcing that its consolidated Ordinary Profits for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 exceeded a 30% change compared to the prior year. This is a routine disclosure required by Tokyo Stock Exchange listing rules. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is involved. The filing is a financial results notice with no deal terms, advisory roles, or structural changes. There is no risk-arb angle or event to monitor.
